description_en: Initiates an intelligent assistant session run over the AG-UI protocol
description_zh: 发起智能助手会话运行（AG-UI 协议）
kebab_example: aliyun cs invoke-agent --thread-id abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 --run-id r-1 --parent-run-id r-0 --state '{}' --forwarded-props language=zh source=user enableThinking=true --messages '[{"metadata":{},"role":"user","toolCallId":"64ea4d94937a4c5c84e2b3b814d14696","subagentRunId":"64ea4d94937a4c5c84e2b3b814d14696","encryptedValue":"\"\"","name":"n-1","id":"m-1","toolCalls":[{"metadata":{},"function":{"name":"xxx","arguments":"xxx"},"encryptedValue":"\"\"","id":"64ea4d94937a4c5c84e2b3b814d14696","type":"function"}],"content":"你好"}]' --tools '[]' --context description=cluster value=c-1 --resume '[{"payload":{"decision":"yes"},"interruptId":"i-1","status":"resolved"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvokeAgent

fields.help_en: The description of the orchestration template
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The environment variable value
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The AG-UI native context array. Each item contains description and value strings. Undeclared extension keys are still passed through. Currently, the downstream service only logs a warning and ignores them. The ACK resource context is carried by forwardedProps.ackContext. If omitted, it is processed as an empty array. Null values are not accepted
parameters.help_zh: AG-UI 原生 context 数组，每项含 description/value 字符串；未声明扩展键仍需透传。当前下游仅告警忽略；ACK 资源上下文由 forwardedProps.ackContext 承载。省略时按空数组处理，不接受 null
parameters.name: context

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable thinking
fields.name: enable_thinking

查询语言。
zh：中文

fields.help_en: The source
fields.name: source

parameters.help_zh: AG-UI 的 ACK 扩展参数：language、enableThinking、source，保留未知扩展
parameters.name: forwarded_props

fields.help_en: The plain text content. This parameter can be omitted when the assistant only calls tools. Currently, only the text of the last user message is consumed
fields.help_zh: 纯文本内容。assistant 仅调用工具时可省略；当前仅消费最后一条 user 消息的文本
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: The encrypted content of the tool invocation. The example is only a placeholder value
fields.help_zh: 工具调用的加密内容。示例仅为占位值
fields.name: encrypted_value

fields.help_en: The message ID
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The metadata
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: The name
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The message role. Valid values: user, developer, system, assistant, and tool. The user role requires text content. The assistant role can contain only toolCalls. The tool role requires content and toolCallId. Multimodal input is not declared in the current phase
fields.help_zh: 消息角色：user/developer/system/assistant/tool；user 需要文本 content，assistant 可只含 toolCalls，tool 需要 content 和 toolCallId；本期不声明多模态输入
fields.name: role

fields.help_en: The sub-agent invocation ID
fields.name: subagent_run_id

fields.help_en: Required when role is set to tool. References the tool_call ID from the previous Mobile-Use Agent response
fields.help_zh: role=tool 时必填，引用上一轮 Mobile-Use Agent 响应的 tool_call id
fields.name: tool_call_id

fields.help_en: The encrypted content. The example is an invalid placeholder value and does not contain real ciphertext
fields.help_zh: 加密内容。示例是无效占位值，不包含真实密文

fields.help_en: The function name
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The function information of the historical tool invocation, including the name and arguments in JSON string format. The actual return values should be preserved in subsequent turns
fields.help_zh: 历史工具调用的函数信息，包含 name 及 JSON 字符串形式的 arguments；续轮应保留实际返回值
fields.name: function

fields.help_en: The trigger ID
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The metadata

fields.help_zh: 工具调用类型，固定为 function

fields.help_zh: assistant 历史消息中的一项结构化工具调用，保留服务端返回的 id、type 和 function
fields.name: tool_calls

parameters.help_en: The AG-UI message list. In the current phase, user input only declares plain text content. Historical assistant and tool messages, as well as toolCalls, are preserved. Only the text of the last user message is consumed. If omitted, it is processed as an empty array. Null values are not accepted. Undeclared extension fields are passed through
parameters.help_zh: AG-UI 消息列表：本期用户输入仅声明纯文本 content；历史 assistant/tool 消息及 toolCalls 保留。仅消费最后一条 user 消息的文本。省略时按空数组处理，不接受 null；未声明扩展字段透传
parameters.name: messages

parameters.help_en: The parent run ID. This parameter is optional and is currently not used by the downstream service
parameters.help_zh: 父运行标识，可省略；当前下游不使用
parameters.name: parent_run_id

fields.help_en: Corresponds to outcome.interrupts[].id, not toolCallId
fields.name: interrupt_id

fields.help_en: The arbitrary JSON response payload. Tool approval uses an object with decision=yes/no, and ask_human uses a string
fields.help_zh: 任意 JSON 应答；工具审批使用 decision=yes/no 的对象，ask_human 使用字符串
fields.name: payload

fields.help_en: The response status. Valid values: resolved and cancelled. Both approval and rejection use resolved, distinguished by payload.decision
fields.help_zh: 应答状态：resolved 或 cancelled。批准和拒绝均使用 resolved，由 payload.decision 区分
fields.name: status

parameters.help_en: The AG-UI interrupt resume response list. Independent of the private protocol approval parameters. A single request must answer the current complete approval batch
parameters.help_zh: AG-UI 中断续跑应答列表，与私有协议审批参数独立；一次请求需回答当前完整审批批次
parameters.name: resume

parameters.help_en: The AG-UI current run ID. Must be explicitly provided as a string. Empty strings are allowed and will be generated by the downstream service. Missing or null values are rejected
parameters.help_zh: AG-UI 本轮运行标识。必须显式提供字符串，允许空字符串，空串由下游生成；缺失或 null 均拒绝
parameters.name: run_id

parameters.help_en: The AG-UI native state. Accepts any JSON value, including null. This parameter is currently not used by the downstream service
parameters.help_zh: AG-UI 原生状态，接受任意 JSON，包括 null；当前下游不使用
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The AG-UI session ID. Must be explicitly provided as a string. If not empty, only 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters [0-9a-f]{32} are accepted. A standard run can be created or resumed by using this ID. If an empty string is provided, the server generates a session ID. A resume operation must use an existing session ID. Missing or null values are rejected. This API only accepts native requests and does not require the stream parameter
parameters.help_zh: AG-UI 会话标识。必须显式提供字符串；非空时仅接受 32 位小写十六进制字符 [0-9a-f]{32}，普通 run 可按该 ID 创建或续聊；空串由服务端生成会话 ID，resume 必须使用已有会话 ID。缺失或 null 均拒绝。本接口只接受原生请求，无需 stream
parameters.name: thread_id

fields.help_en: The description of the check item
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The metadata
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: The environment variable name
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The optional JSON Schema for tool parameters. Cannot be null. The internal structure is defined by the tool
fields.help_zh: 可选的工具参数 JSON Schema；非 null，内部结构由工具定义
fields.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The AG-UI native tool definitions. The name and description are strings, and parameters is an opaque JSON Schema. Accepted and passed through. Currently, the downstream service only logs a warning and ignores them. Frontend tool injection is not supported. If omitted, it is processed as an empty array. Null values are not accepted
parameters.help_zh: AG-UI 原生工具定义：name/description 为字符串，parameters 为不透明 JSON Schema。接受并透传，当前下游仅告警忽略，不支持前端注入工具。省略时按空数组处理，不接受 null
parameters.name: tools
